WITH date_series AS (
    SELECT DATE('2017-01-01') + INTERVAL (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY 1) - 1) DAY as sale_date
    FROM generate_series(0, 605)
),
daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) as sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.sale_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ds.sale_date) - 1 as day_number,
        COALESCE(d.daily_sales, 0) as daily_sales
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN daily_sales d ON ds.sale_date = d.sale_date
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_number) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_number) as intercept
    FROM combined
),
predicted_days AS (
    SELECT 
        pdn.day_number,
        r.slope * CAST(pdn.day_number AS DOUBLE) + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM regression r
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES (701), (702), (703), (704), (705), (706), (707), (708)) AS pdn(day_number)
),
target_days AS (
    SELECT unnest([703, 704, 705, 706]) as target_day
),
moving_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        t.target_day,
        AVG(p.predicted_sales) as moving_avg
    FROM target_days t
    JOIN predicted_days p ON p.day_number BETWEEN t.target_day - 2 AND t.target_day + 2
    GROUP BY t.target_day
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg) as sum_of_moving_averages
FROM moving_avgs

-- Final result: Average sales per order by RFM segment
WITH customer_rfm AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as frequency,
    SUM(op.payment_value) as monetary,
    CAST(DATEDIFF('day', MAX(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)), CAST('2018-08-29 15:00:37' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) as recency_days
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
rfm_scored AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    frequency,
    monetary,
    recency_days,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) as r_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) as f_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) as m_score
  FROM customer_rfm
),
rfm_with_segment AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    frequency,
    monetary,
    recency_days,
    r_score,
    f_score,
    m_score,
    CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) as rfm_score,
    CASE
      WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
      WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
      WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
      WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
      WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
      WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
      WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
      WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
      WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8 THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
      WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
      WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
      WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END as rfm_segment
  FROM rfm_scored
)
SELECT 
  rfm_segment,
  COUNT(*) as num_customers,
  SUM(frequency) as total_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(monetary), 2) as total_spend,
  ROUND(AVG(monetary * 1.0 / frequency), 2) as avg_sales_per_order
FROM rfm_with_segment
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

-- Final query: top 3 customers by average payment per order, properly ordered
WITH order_payments_total AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_id,
        SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id
),
customer_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(order_id) AS num_orders,
        AVG(total_payment) AS avg_payment_per_order
    FROM order_payments_total
    GROUP BY customer_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(total_payment) DESC) <= 3
),
customer_lifespan AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(date_diff('day', MIN(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)), MAX(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))) AS DOUBLE) / 7.0 < 1.0 
            THEN 1.0
            ELSE CAST(date_diff('day', MIN(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)), MAX(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))) AS DOUBLE) / 7.0
        END AS lifespan_weeks
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    ca.customer_id,
    ca.num_orders,
    ca.avg_payment_per_order,
    cl.lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_avg ca
JOIN customer_lifespan cl ON ca.customer_id = cl.customer_id
ORDER BY ca.avg_payment_per_order DESC

WITH valid_players AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    debut,
    final_game
  FROM player
  WHERE debut != '' AND final_game != ''
),
career_spans AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE)))), 2) 
      + ROUND(ABS(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE)))), 2) / 12.0 
      + ROUND(ABS(EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE)))), 2) / 365.0 as career_span
  FROM valid_players
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) as avg_career_span
FROM career_spans

WITH player_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        b.player_id,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE)) as total_g,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE)) as total_r,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE)) as total_h,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE)) as total_hr,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE)) as total_score
    FROM batting b
    WHERE TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.player_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.*,
        p.name_given,
        p.name_first,
        p.name_last,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_score DESC) as rnk
    FROM player_scores ps
    JOIN player p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id
)
SELECT name_given, total_g, total_r, total_h, total_hr, total_score
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1

WITH route_distances AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        dep.airport_code AS dep_code,
        arr.airport_code AS arr_code,
        dep.city AS dep_city,
        arr.city AS arr_city,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lon,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lat,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lon,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lat
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
    WHERE dep.city LIKE '%Abakan%' OR arr.city LIKE '%Abakan%'
)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
        + COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180)
        * POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
    ))
)) AS max_distance_km
FROM route_distances

-- Let me now count the pairs per distance range and find the range with the fewest pairs
WITH flight_data AS (
  SELECT 
    f.departure_airport,
    f.arrival_airport,
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE(dep.city, '""', '"') AS JSON)->>'en' as dep_city,
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE(arr.city, '""', '"') AS JSON)->>'en' as arr_city,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM TRIM(LEADING '(' FROM CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR))), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM TRIM(LEADING '(' FROM CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR))), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lat,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM TRIM(LEADING '(' FROM CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR))), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM TRIM(LEADING '(' FROM CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR))), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lat
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
flight_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    dep_city,
    arr_city,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
      COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) *
      POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
    )) as distance_km
  FROM flight_data
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    LEAST(dep_city, arr_city) as city1,
    GREATEST(dep_city, arr_city) as city2,
    distance_km
  FROM flight_distances
),
avg_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    AVG(distance_km) as avg_distance
  FROM city_pairs
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
with_range AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0-1000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000-2000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000-3000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000-4000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000-5000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000-6000'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END as distance_range
  FROM avg_distances
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    distance_range,
    COUNT(*) as pair_count
  FROM with_range
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT 
  distance_range,
  pair_count
FROM range_counts
ORDER BY pair_count ASC, distance_range ASC

-- Final query to compute fatality rates by helmet usage
WITH motorcycle_collisions AS (
    SELECT 
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_helmet_used,
        MAX(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_helmet_not_used
    FROM collisions c
    LEFT JOIN parties p ON CAST(c.case_id AS DOUBLE) = p.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
),
classified AS (
    SELECT 
        case_id,
        motorcyclist_killed_count,
        CASE 
            WHEN has_helmet_used = 1 AND has_helmet_not_used = 0 THEN 'helmet used'
            WHEN has_helmet_not_used = 1 AND has_helmet_used = 0 THEN 'helmet not used'
            ELSE 'neither'
        END as helmet_group
    FROM motorcycle_collisions
)
SELECT 
    helmet_group,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) as total_collisions,
    CAST(SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) AS INTEGER) as motorcyclist_fatalities,
    ROUND(CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) / COUNT(*) * 100 
        ELSE NULL 
    END, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM classified
WHERE helmet_group IN ('helmet used', 'helmet not used')
GROUP BY helmet_group

WITH yearly_top2 AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year, pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) as cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn 
  FROM collisions 
  WHERE pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category != '' 
  GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER), pcf_violation_category
)
SELECT year, STRING_AGG(pcf_violation_category, ', ' ORDER BY cnt DESC) as top2_causes
FROM yearly_top2 
WHERE rn <= 2 
GROUP BY year 
ORDER BY year

SELECT 
  'speeding' as pcf_violation_category,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collisions WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2011' AND pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
    ) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collisions WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2011') * 100
    -
    1.0 * (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collisions WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2021' AND pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
    ) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collisions WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2021') * 100
  , 2) as decrease_pct_points

SELECT b.name AS belt_name, m.duration, w1.name AS winner_name, w2.name AS loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = CAST(b.id AS TEXT)
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = CAST(w1.id AS TEXT)
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = CAST(w2.id AS TEXT)
WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%' AND m.title_change = 0 AND m.duration != ''
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, 1, INSTR(m.duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, INSTR(m.duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1

-- Final query for top 3 bowlers
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
match_max AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        o.match_id,
        o.over_id,
        o.innings_no,
        o.bowler,
        o.total_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN match_max m ON o.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE o.total_runs = m.max_runs
),
bowler_with_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM max_overs
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, CAST(total_runs AS INTEGER) as max_runs_in_over
    FROM bowler_with_rank
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    bm.bowler as player_id,
    p.player_name,
    bm.match_id,
    bm.max_runs_in_over
FROM bowler_max bm
JOIN player p ON bm.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bm.max_runs_in_over DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT bw.bowler, p.player_name, bw.wickets, br.runs_conceded, 
       br.runs_conceded * 1.0 / bw.wickets as bowling_avg
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 1

-- Step 1: Find strikers who scored > 50 in any single match
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker, bbb.match_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
      ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
      AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
      AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
      AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE total_runs > 50
)
-- Step 2: Average of total runs scored by these qualifying strikers (across all their matches)
SELECT AVG(smr.total_runs) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_match_runs smr
WHERE smr.striker IN (SELECT striker FROM qualifying_strikers)

FROM batsman_scored b
JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON b.match_id = bb.match_id

JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON bb.striker = p.player_id
WHERE bb.team_batting != m.match_winner
GROUP BY p.player_name, bb.match_id, bb.team_batting, m.match_winner, m.team_1, m.team_2
HAVING SUM(b.runs_scored) >= 100
ORDER BY p.player_name;

WITH season5_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, 
           SUM(b.runs_scored) as total_runs,
           COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) as matches_batted
    FROM batsman_scored b
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON b.match_id = bb.match_id 
      AND b.over_id = bb.over_id 
      AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
      AND b.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
season5_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN match m2 ON wt.match_id = m2.match_id
    WHERE m2.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY player_out
),
season5_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(1.0 * s5r.total_runs / s5m.matches_played, 2) as avg_runs_per_match,
    ROUND(1.0 * s5r.total_runs / NULLIF(COALESCE(s5d.dismissals, 0), 0), 2) as batting_average
FROM season5_runs s5r
JOIN player p ON s5r.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN season5_matches s5m ON s5r.player_id = s5m.player_id
LEFT JOIN season5_dismissals s5d ON s5r.player_id = s5d.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, pm.match_id
    FROM player_match pm
),
player_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(b.runs_scored) as total_runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored b 
        ON bb.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = b.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as num_matches,
        COALESCE(SUM(prm.total_runs_in_match), 0) as total_runs
    FROM player_matches pm
    LEFT JOIN player_runs_per_match prm 
        ON pm.player_id = prm.player_id AND pm.match_id = prm.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.player_id,
        p.country_name,
        CASE WHEN pt.num_matches > 0 THEN 1.0 * pt.total_runs / pt.num_matches ELSE 0 END as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_totals pt
    JOIN player p ON pt.player_id = p.player_id
)
SELECT 
    country_name,
    AVG(avg_runs_per_match) as country_avg_runs_per_match
FROM player_averages
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY country_avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Final calculation of average highest over total runs across all matches
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT bbs.match_id, bbs.innings_no, bbs.over_id, bbs.bowler,
           COALESCE(SUM(bms.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbs
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bms ON bbs.match_id = bms.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bms.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bms.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bms.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bbs.match_id = er.match_id AND bbs.over_id = er.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbs.match_id, bbs.innings_no, bbs.over_id, bbs.bowler
),

WITH sorted_data AS (
    SELECT 
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS rn
    FROM olist_geolocation
),
consecutive_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.geolocation_state AS state1,
        s1.geolocation_city AS city1,
        s1.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip1,
        s1.geolocation_lat AS lat1,
        s1.geolocation_lng AS lng1,
        s2.geolocation_state AS state2,
        s2.geolocation_city AS city2,
        s2.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip2,
        s2.geolocation_lat AS lat2,
        s2.geolocation_lng AS lng2,
        6371 * ACOS(
            LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0,
                COS(RADIANS(s1.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(s2.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(s2.geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(s1.geolocation_lng)) +
                SIN(RADIANS(s1.geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(s2.geolocation_lat))
            ))
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM sorted_data s1
    JOIN sorted_data s2 ON s1.rn = s2.rn - 1
)
SELECT * FROM consecutive_pairs
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (

WITH sales_by_year AS (

SELECT 
    COALESCE(s.businessentityid, q.BusinessEntityID) AS businessentityid,

    ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0), 2) AS total_sales,
    ROUND(COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0), 2) AS annual_quota,

FROM sales_by_year s

WITH txn_data AS (

    WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'

region_year_totals AS (

    FROM txn_data

    FROM region_year_totals
    WHERE year > (
        SELECT MIN(year) FROM region_year_totals r2 WHERE r2.region = region_year_totals.region
    )
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        year,

        ROUND(avg_price, 2) AS avg_price,

WITH customer_first AS (

           p.amount,
           p.payment_date,
           cf.first_payment_date,
           (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM p.payment_date) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM cf.first_payment_date)) / 3600.0 as hours_since_first
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first cf ON p.customer_id = cf.customer_id
),
customer_early_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        pwc.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pwc.hours_since_first <= 168 THEN pwc.amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_7days,

    GROUP BY pwc.customer_id, cl.total_ltv
    HAVING cl.total_ltv > 0
)

-- Final answer: First 10 words, sorted alphabetically, with total anagram count (including self)
-- Words are 4-5 chars, start with 'r', and have at least one other anagram
WITH unique_words AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words, LENGTH(words) as len
  FROM word_list 
  WHERE words IS NOT NULL AND words != ''
    AND words LIKE 'r%'
    AND len BETWEEN 4 AND 5
),
char_expanded AS (
  SELECT words, len, 
    SUBSTR(words, gs.n, 1) as char
  FROM unique_words
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, LENGTH(words)) AS gs(n)
),
word_sorted AS (
  SELECT words, len, STRING_AGG(char, '' ORDER BY char) as sorted_chars
  FROM char_expanded
  GROUP BY words, len
),
word_anagram_count AS (
  SELECT words, len, sorted_chars,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sorted_chars) as anagram_count
  FROM word_sorted
)
SELECT DISTINCT words, anagram_count
FROM word_anagram_count
WHERE anagram_count >= 2
ORDER BY words
LIMIT 10

    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON o.order_id = d.delivery_order_id
    WHERE o.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM top_store)
    GROUP BY o.store_id

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) as time_step
    FROM monthly_sales 
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.product_id,
        s1.time_step,
        s1.mth,
        s1.qty as actual_sales,
        (AVG(s2.qty) FILTER (WHERE s2.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 5 AND s1.time_step + 6) +
         AVG(s3.qty) FILTER (WHERE s3.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 6 AND s1.time_step + 5)) / 2.0 as cma,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s1.mth::DATE) as month_num
    FROM sales_data s1
    JOIN sales_data s2 ON s2.product_id = s1.product_id AND s2.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 5 AND s1.time_step + 6
    JOIN sales_data s3 ON s3.product_id = s1.product_id AND s3.time_step BETWEEN s1.time_step - 6 AND s1.time_step + 5
    WHERE s1.time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    GROUP BY s1.product_id, s1.time_step, s1.mth, s1.qty
),
weighted_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(cma) as sum_w,
        SUM(cma * time_step) as sum_wx,
        SUM(cma * cma) as sum_wy,
        SUM(cma * time_step * time_step) as sum_wxx,
        SUM(cma * time_step * cma) as sum_wxy
    FROM cma_calc
    GROUP BY product_id
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w) as slope,
        (sum_wy / sum_w) - (sum_wx / sum_w) * ((sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w)) as intercept
    FROM weighted_stats
),
seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_num,
        AVG(CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN 1.0 * actual_sales / cma ELSE NULL END) as raw_factor
    FROM cma_calc
    GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
norm_seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_num,
        raw_factor / AVG(raw_factor) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) as seasonality_factor
    FROM seasonality
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        r.product_id,
        f.time_step,
        (r.slope * f.time_step + r.intercept) * ns.seasonality_factor as forecast_actual
    FROM regression r
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(generate_series(25, 36)) as time_step) f
    JOIN norm_seasonality ns ON ns.product_id = r.product_id 
        AND ns.month_num = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (DATE '2018-01-01' + ((f.time_step - 25) || ' months')::INTERVAL)::DATE)
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    ROUND(SUM(forecast_actual), 2) as average_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

inv_model AS (
    SELECT 
        s.product_id,
        m.mth,
        m.month_num,
        s.starting_qty AS beginning_inv,
        COALESCE(b.qty, 0) AS sales,
        pm.qty_minimum,
        pm.qty_purchase,
        s.starting_qty - COALESCE(b.qty, 0) AS ending_inv,
        ABS(s.starting_qty - COALESCE(b.qty, 0) - pm.qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM start_inv s
    JOIN months m ON m.month_num = 1
    JOIN product_minimums pm ON s.product_id = pm.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b ON s.product_id = b.product_id AND m.mth = b.mth
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        im.product_id,
        m.mth,
        m.month_num,
        CASE WHEN im.ending_inv < im.qty_minimum 
             THEN im.ending_inv + im.qty_purchase 
             ELSE im.ending_inv 
        END AS beginning_inv,
        COALESCE(b.qty, 0) AS sales,
        im.qty_minimum,
        im.qty_purchase,
        CASE WHEN im.ending_inv < im.qty_minimum 
             THEN im.ending_inv + im.qty_purchase - COALESCE(b.qty, 0)
             ELSE im.ending_inv - COALESCE(b.qty, 0)
        END AS ending_inv,
        ABS(CASE WHEN im.ending_inv < im.qty_minimum 
             THEN im.ending_inv + im.qty_purchase - COALESCE(b.qty, 0)
             ELSE im.ending_inv - COALESCE(b.qty, 0)
        END - im.qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM inv_model im
    JOIN months m ON m.month_num = im.month_num + 1
    JOIN product_minimums pm ON im.product_id = pm.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b ON im.product_id = b.product_id AND m.mth = b.mth
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff, mth) AS rn
    FROM inv_model
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id

SELECT DISTINCT drv.forename, drv.surname, drv.nationality
FROM first_race_constructor frc
JOIN last_race_constructor lrc ON frc.year = lrc.year AND frc.driver_id = lrc.driver_id
JOIN driver_first_last dfl ON frc.year = dfl.year AND frc.driver_id = dfl.driver_id
JOIN drivers drv ON frc.driver_id = drv.driver_id
WHERE frc.constructor_id = lrc.constructor_id
ORDER BY drv.surname, drv.forename

-- Build the full query with the interpretation that we use drives table
-- First, let me check all gap cases again
WITH multi_stint AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round, drive_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as stint_num
    FROM drives
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, a.stint_num, a.first_round as prev_first, a.last_round as prev_last, a.constructor_id as prev_constructor,
           b.first_round as next_first, b.last_round as next_last, b.constructor_id as next_constructor
    FROM multi_stint a
    JOIN multi_stint b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.stint_num = b.stint_num - 1
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, 
           prev_last + 1 as hiatus_first_round,
           next_first - 1 as hiatus_last_round,
           next_first - prev_last - 1 as races_missed
    FROM consecutive
)
SELECT * FROM with_gaps
WHERE races_missed > 0 AND races_missed < 3 AND prev_constructor != next_constructor
ORDER BY year, driver_id
